title: Tesla expands robotaxi service to San Antonio

claims.claim: Tesla, robotaksi servisini yerel saatle pazartesi günü saat 05.00'ten itibaren San Antonio'da kullanıma sunacağını X platformunda duyurdu.

evidence.quote: The company said in a post on X that it will make its robotaxis available in San Antonio starting at 5 a.m. local time on Monday.

claims.claim: Tesla, Austin'deki robotaksi servisini Haziran 2025'te başlattı.

evidence.quote: it eventually launched a robotaxi service in Austin in June 2025.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk for a decade promised his company would deliver autonomous vehicles, and it eventually launched a robotaxi service in Austin in June 2025.

claims.claim: Tesla, ocak ayında Austin'deki robotaksilerinden güvenlik görevlilerini kaldırarak gerçek sürücüsüz hizmet başlattı.

evidence.quote: In January, the company removed safety monitors from its robotaxis in Austin, officially kicking off a true driverless service

claims.claim: Tesla; Miami, Orlando, Dallas, Fort Worth ve Houston şehirlerinin sınırlı bölgelerinde robotaksi işletmektedir.

evidence.quote: It now operates robotaxis in limited areas of Miami and Orlando as well as Dallas, Fort Worth, and Houston.

claims.claim: Waymo, Austin, Dallas, Houston ve San Antonio'da sürücüsüz Jaguar I-Pace ve Zeekr RT araçlarıyla robotaksi hizmeti vermektedir.

evidence.quote: Its rival Waymo also operates a robotaxi service using a mix of driverless Jaguar I-Pace and Zeekr RT vehicles, branded Ojai, in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio.

claims.claim: Texas araç kayıt verileri ve Robotaxi Tracker web sitesine göre Tesla'nın Austin filosunda 400'den fazla otonom araç bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: While Tesla has more than 400 autonomous vehicles registered in its Austin fleet, its fleets in other cities have numbered between a handful and a few dozen, according to Texas vehicle registration data and the Robotaxi Tracker website.

claims.claim: Robotaxi Tracker verilerine göre Tesla'nın Fort Worth'te 24, Miami'de ise 5 aracı bulunmaktadır.

evidence.quote: For example, Tesla has just 24 vehicles in Fort Worth and five in Miami, according to the tracker.

claims.claim: TechCrunch'ın temmuz ayındaki haberine göre Tesla'nın robotaksi ağı ikinci çeyrekte, ilk çeyreğe göre ücretli yolcularla daha az mil katetti.

evidence.quote: In spite of this expansion push, the company released data this summer that showed its robotaxi network drove fewer miles with paying customers in the second quarter than it did in the first, TechCrunch reported in July.
